|lore=Scout. Leader. Made friends with Wicket. Negotiated an alliance with the Ewoks. Leia found out the truth about her father from Luke in the Ewok village.
|strategy=By Jim Van Fleet<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/daughterofskywalker.html</ref>

This card is arguably the best version of [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] so far. Ability 5 means she can easily use most lightsabers, and draw battle destiny to go along with her 4 power. Immunity to attrition &lt;4 means she'll hang around at the end of a battle. [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] finally has numbers like a Jedi. Warrior, pilot, scout and leader adds amazing versatility. In [[Endor (expansion){{!}}Endor]] booster draft play she's very hard to beat, and a best friend to all your Ewoks! We are already seeing Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] in tournament play, replacing [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] on Dagobah and completing Jedi Tests. She even shares Yodas ability to add a Light side Force icon (at exterior sites) for extra Force generation (and +1 power and forfeit for your Ewoks). Daughter of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] also looks good in foil.

Combos: - holds down a Force drain of 4. DoS Minding What She Has Learned, and hauling [[Yoda]] around with [[Luke's Backpack]]; she finishes Jedi Tests easily, and makes a great mental picture.
|combos=* [[Daughter Of Skywalker]] + [[Jerus Jannick]]<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json complete card data], entry <code>8_8</code>, <code>combo</code> and <code>rulings</code>. A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Endor-L-daughterofskywalker-PC-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Daughter Of Skywalker]]: The game text changes: “deployed” becomes “targeted”. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
